text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, for this year's Tenno Sho (Spring),
an extraordinary lineup of unique Umamusume has gathered!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Having shown off incredible talent across multiple GⅠs last year,
Mejiro Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Just watch, I'll carve the name 'Palmer' into this grand stage."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Palmer!

Her era begins right here!
In peak physical condition, it's Ikuno Dictus!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: This time for sure, I will seize it.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Show 'em what you're truly made of!

Carrying greater passion for the Tenno Sho (Spring)
than anyone else—the overwhelming favorite, Mejiro McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
On the pride of our Mejiro family...
The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the one race I will never yield.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it this year, too!
Give it your all~!

"And captivating the eyes of all who watched at the Kikuka Sho—
the embodiment of pure effort, Rice Shower!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Miss Bourbon.
Rice is going to fight... Rice will go and win...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Rice! You can definitely do it!

And the bundle of endless potential,
Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to working with you!
(Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I made sure to get my body in top shape for today!
I'm fully fired up!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Matikanetannhauser! If I remember right,
she ran in the Classic series last year, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text: I've seen the post-race comments before, and they were great. Ran pretty well in the Diamond Stakes, too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Huh! I wonder if that girl might unexpectedly show up today?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right,
I'll do my best~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
"Show me what you've got,
Matikanetannhauser!"

With sparks flying between various Umamusume, the
Tenno Sho (Spring) has finally begun...!
